root_cause_label: Configure failure blocked build; manual workaround strategy never produced a working OCaml runtime or testsuite
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent failed to diagnose the root cause of the persistent configure script failure (cat: -: No such file or directory), pivoted at step 35 to manually creating incomplete build configuration files, and then spent the remainder of the trajectory on ad-hoc compilation scripts and speculative GC code edits that never produced a working build or passing testsuite.
t_err_evidence: At step 35 the agent creates a manual /app/ocaml/Makefile.config to bypass the configure failure, adopting a false premise that manual configuration files could substitute for the autoconf-generated artifacts; this commits the agent to a strategy that cannot produce a working build because config.status, generated headers (m.h, s.h), and dozens of other autoconf-substituted variables are still absent.
t_commit_evidence: Creating the manual Makefile.config at step 35 locks the trajectory into an ad-hoc workaround path; all subsequent steps (manual Makefile.build_config, touch config.status, header hacks, ad-hoc gcc scripts) are downstream of this wrong pivot and cannot succeed without a proper configure.
t_surface_evidence: At step 38, 'make world' explicitly fails with 'Makefile.build_config: No such file or directory' and 'make: *** [Makefile:3018: config.status] Error 1', visibly showing that the manual Makefile.config workaround cannot unblock the build.
trigger_explanation: The configure script fails repeatedly (steps 7, 13, 15) with 'cat: -: No such file or directory' when trying to create config.status — a real environment blocker. Rather than diagnosing the cause (a bug in the configure script's pipe handling) or trying a workaround like running configure with --disable-dependency-tracking or patching the script, the agent at step 35 abandons configure entirely and tries to manually fabricate build artifacts, which is fundamentally unworkable for the full OCaml build system.
forewarning_evidence: Configure fails with the same error at steps 7, 13, and 15 ('cat: -: No such file or directory / configure: error: could not make ./config.status'); running autoconf at step 14 does not help, and the identical error repeats, signaling the issue is environmental and will persist without targeted diagnosis.
